verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a public REST API with Python and TypeScript SDKs, a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json, and per-endpoint reference covering runs, agents, browser sessions and credentials. It also documents API-key authentication and a formal versioning/deprecation policy with RFC 9745/8594 headers. The probe 404s on skyvern.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is served from the api subdomain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
